title: Infused Crystal Pickaxe
text: Mining ores has a 20% chance to yield an extra Spiritual Crystal.
While held in either hand, it spends 5 mana every half second to repair one durability. Cost reductions do not apply. No mana is spent at full durability or with insufficient mana.
Upgrade a crystal pickaxe at a crafting table, or place it in the assembly bench's center with one spiritual crystal, one iron ingot and one diamond in any three outer slots. Leave the others empty.
